<h2>Seas the Breeze II - 102 in Avon, NC - Soundfront Vacation Home<br />Windsports Paradise - <a title="Looney Dunes 5-Star Reviews" href="https://www.hatterasislandvacationrentals.com/seas-the-breeze-ii-orp5b5e666x#reviews"><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><span style="font-size: 18pt;">★★★★★</span></span></a></h2>
<p><p>Seas the Breeze II #102 in Avon, NC with private windsports access!</p><p>Watersport novices and pros alike agree: the miles of open shallow waters and favorable breezes make Pamlico Sound an indomitable draw for passionate wind and kite surfers and young families alike. SEAS the BREEZE ll is another. Connected to a private beach oasis via a direct boardwalk, this 5,100-square-foot home features 10 spacious primary bedrooms, all with ensuite bathrooms featuring tiled showers, and is expertly designed to strike the ideal balance between private retreats and enlivened communal gatherings. </p><p>That duo-dynamic starts on the ground level, where a 14’x28’ sound front pool provides an inviting spot to soak in the sun while the sound’s iconic breezes serve as a natural fan. A tiki bar equipped with a Smart TV stands ready to quench your thirst and an eight-person hot tub is the ideal antidote to soothe well-used muscles after a day of wind- and kitesurfing. An outside gear closet provides ample space to store your paddleboards, kayaks, and beach stuff when you’re off on other Outer Banks adventures. When you are ready to put that gear into the water, one of the best uncrowded kite beaches is just steps away with easy access to launch and land kites and boards for some of the most exhilarating rides of your life. Families with kids, too, will appreciate the calm sound waters and private sandy beach as the perfect playground.</p><p>Three of the home’s bedrooms, including two primary kings and a kid-approved two-pyramid bunkroom, are located on the first level along with a theater room with 85&quot; Smart TV!  For those who start their morning with an invigorating workout, an exercise room featuring state-of-the art cardio equipment, Smart TV and large bay windows that fill the room with light and stirring views is conveniently located on this floor, too. Yoga enthusiasts might want to start the day on the deck, as a cool breeze blows off the sound. Just off the deck, a large game room inspires lively competition with a Smart TV, pool table, shuffleboard and arcade games. Relax in the media room, smartly furnished to enjoy streaming your favorite movies on a 85-inch Smart TV enhanced by surround sound while enjoying beverages from the built-in bar.  Moving between levels is made all the easier thanks to an elevator. Five more primary king bedrooms are located on the second level as is a home office that allows you to work in a quiet space with a Smart TV and an inspired view. Those views are also readily available from the home’s front and back deck, where there is also a screened in porch. </p><p>On the third level, two more primary king bedrooms are ideal for those who like to be close to where family and friends gather for meals, multi-media entertainment and many more memorable moments. The gleaming chef’s kitchen features premium stainless appliances, including two refrigerators — perfect for feeding a hungry crowd. Two dining tables — one seating eight and the other 12, along with seating for four at the breakfast bar — accommodate 24 for those meals that extend well into the evening. Gather in the spacious living room where a 65-inch Smart TV and LED fireplace is sure to pull you into a place of pure relaxation. That restful feeling starts after booking SEAS THE BREEZE ll today.</p><p>This home is directly on the sound front.  Take the walkway directly from the pool to the water with steps leading down to a sandy beach.  Or continue down the walkway to the dock with private benches &amp; pergola over the water. A private kayak launch on this home&#39;s private dock awaits you.  Or, bring your own boat and park it at one of two private boat slips and make this a vacation like no other!</p><p>New Construction: This home finished construction in June 2023.<br/>Sister Home: This is one of two identical homes sitting beside each other – rent one or both vacation homes for your group. Or if this home is already rented for your week, take a look at its sister home 101 Seas the Breeze I. </p><p>For kiteboarders, wind surfers and the like, this home is located on the sound front just north of Canadian Hole, Kite Point, and Long Point in an area that can be kited regardless of wind direction!</p><p>Guest can cancel for any reason with partial refund when you purchase Cancel For Any Reason Travel Insurance.<br/>Cancel For Any Reason Travel insurance can be purchased within 14 days of booking.<br/>Standard Travel Insurance can also be purchase anytime 30 days or more prior to check-in date.</p><p>This property has a pool that can be heated for $600. When pool heat is purchased, heaters are set to 85 degrees, but pool temperature cannot be guaranteed.  Pool is open April 1st - October 31st.</p><p>Dogs welcome with pet fee for each dog.</p><p>Full linens including sheets (with beds made), bath towels, hand towels, wash cloths provided all year.<br/>Additional linens and towels available on request.</p><p>10 Master Bedrooms<br/>14 Smart TVs up to 85-inch<br/>2 Dishwashers<br/>2 Refrigerators/Freezers<br/>2 Washers/Dryers<br/>Kitchenette<br/>Theater room with 85&quot; TV &amp; surround sound<br/>Game room with shuffleboard and pool table<br/>Exercise room<br/>Indoor &amp; Outdoor Bluetooth Speakers (Living Room, Game Room, &amp; Pool Deck)<br/>Grill - charcoal<br/>Elevator <br/>Private swimming pool; heat available<br/>Tiki bar<br/>8-Person hot tub<br/>Screened-in porch<br/>Private windsurfing access <br/>Office<br/>Dog friendly</p><p>This home is owned &amp; managed by Hatteras Island Vacation Rentals.</p><p>More payment options available after booking.</p></p>
<h3>Indoor &amp; Outdoor Bluetooth Speakers</h3>
<p>This home is equipped with multiple sets of independent bluetooth speakers capable of playing wireless music from your personal devices such as phones, tablets, etc.</p>
<ul>
<li>There are 2 independent indoor touchscreen bluetooth control units located in the Living Room and Game Room <a href="https://uc.orez.io/f/a6d55c6a50a74254b254bc45060329e2">[Indoor Touchscreen Bluetooth Speaker Instructions]</a>.</li>
<li>There is also an outdoor bluetooth control unit at the tiki bar <a href="https://uc.orez.io/f/b1e98a87c923497892b42df31f2e3852">[Outdoor Bluetooth Speaker Instructions]</a>.</li>
</ul>

                    <h2 class="page-header">About the Owner</h2>
Russ has owned and managed rental real estate for 20+ years. He is native to North Carolina. He and his 3 kids stay in each of their upscale Hatteras Island homes in the Outer Banks many times throughout each year seeking the same unique experience as each of our guests. Premium quality homes and top notch customer service are of utmost importance!                </div>
